newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta and Pine Land hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta and Pine Land hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she began coverage of Delta and Pine Land Co with a hold rating due to valuation and concerns about potential shortfalls compared to Wall Street expectations of total cotton acreage or higher-margin Bt cotton acreage in 1997.
-- "DLP stock is not cheap and near term we worry that consensus estimates may be too high," Wittenburg said.
-- She added that any shortfall in expectations regarding seed ramp-up, opportunity in China and near-term cotton acreage could "cause this stock to fall."
-- Delta and Pine shares were unchanged at 36-1/8.
-- She added that Delta and Pine shares are currently trading at 40 times her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $0.90 a share and 27 times her 1998 estimate of $1.35.

-- Wittenburg also raised concerns about U.S. Justice Department approval of Delta and Pine's proposed purchase of the Sure Grow Cos. She said if the deal is not approved, Delta and Pine shares would react negatively.

-- "Delta and Pine Land's overall, long-term story looks good, in our opinion, although there is considerable risk regarding the pace of international growth and the pace of growth in the United States for higher-margin transgenic cottonseed products," Wittenburg said.
